points.quote: You have followed the chain from voltage on a wire to JSON on a screen and back.
points.problem: The caption of Fig 18.6 runs to about eight sentences and re-lists the whole book. The figure shows only six nested frames, and the caption is the main text block on the phone screen. It breaks the two-sentence caption limit and restates what the text above it already says. It also leans on 'Kubernetes cluster' and 'AWS region' for a reader who may not hold them, while the picture itself never mentions them.
points.hint: Cut the caption to at most two sentences naming the picture (transistor at the centre, five frames out to civilization). Move any remaining prose to a body paragraph or drop it.
